author: claude
desc: dwm LOADS on the panel (tags 1-9, []= layout, st title, dwm-6.8 status, blue border, shell prompt in st) from object 6738aad9 — so Xorg started, modesetting drove simpledrm, and every blocker from tickets 148/155 is cleared. But NEITHER KEYBOARD NOR MOUSE RESPONDS. Cause: xf86-input-libinput discovers and classifies input devices through libudev, and the image had libudev.so.1 (a dependency of Xorg/libinput) but NO udevd and NO udevadm binary, so the udev database was never populated and Xorg auto-add enumerated zero devices. The keyboard itself is fine — event0 works at the console and the B0 health report consistently shows Handlers=sysrq kbd leds event0 for the Apple DockChannel Keyboard. The dead mouse is separate and expected (trackpad unsupported, tickets 004/126), which is why the design sets AllowMouseOpenFail true and uses a keyboard-driven WM.
result: 2026-07-26 PASS. Object 3ec81ef3 gives dwm WITH WORKING KEYBOARD on the internal panel: Alt+Shift+Return spawns a new terminal, Alt+p opens dmenu, and the Norwegian layout is correct (ae/oe/aa) via setxkbmap no. Trackpad still dead, as designed and expected (004/126). eudev was the fix: the image had libudev.so.1 as a dependency but no udevd/udevadm, so the udev database was empty and xf86-input-libinput enumerated zero devices. FOLLOW-UP, now built: text rendered extremely small because the panel is ~254 DPI while X assumes 96. The pre-existing 'xrandr --dpi 192' could never have fixed st, since Alpine builds st with a PIXELSIZE font that ignores DPI entirely. Three mechanisms were needed: the server's -dpi, Xft.dpi via .Xresources+xrdb (the only lever for dwm's bar and dmenu, whose fonts are compile-time monospace:size=10 in the suckless config), and an explicit st -f monospace:pixelsize=28. xrdb was not previously installed at all, so Xft.dpi could not have been loaded. Object m1n1-b0-dwm-hidpi.bin 59622e78685961a322308643b03eae6db0dd3ee985b5674e0b3e6831d605a270 (28,459,008 B = 1737 x 16 KiB, strict PASS), identical to 3ec81ef3 except the initramfs 47d1e8ce — so exactly one variable changed and it cannot regress input or graphics. T6040_DPI (default 192) and T6040_ST_PIXELSIZE (default 28) are tunable at boot; 254 is the panel's true DPI. Evidence: done/2026-07-26-t6040-dwm-working-hidpi.md.
